title: Why Do Zebras Have Stripes?
excerpt: Why do zebras have stripes? Scientists have tested several theories. Here is what the evidence suggests.
body:
## The theories

- **Camouflage:** stripes confuse predators when a herd runs.
- **Temperature:** stripes may help regulate heat.
- **Social recognition:** every pattern is unique.
- **Biting flies:** research suggests stripes make it harder for horseflies and tsetse flies to land.

## The current view

Several studies support the fly theory as an important explanation, though more than one factor may play a role.

## Plains zebra

The zebras in Tanzania are plains zebras. They migrate with the wildebeest. See [migration facts](/blog/great-migration-facts/).

## Unique

No two zebras have the same pattern.
